## Synthetic architecture image

![Generated green and cream bands crossed by an orange diagonal marker][architecture-image]

## Synthetic JPEG

## Controlled GIF

The generated stripe movement tests explicit playback without representing product behavior.

![Generated diagonal stripes shifting between two positions](/media/media-policy-demo/interaction.gif)

The explanation remains available while the animation is stopped.
